messages:
mira: Quick question — can we give oncall@sre group a read-only view into LLM trace rows (only redacted user text) in BigQuery/console for debugging? Want least-privilege, no project-level viewer.

alex: Short answer: yes, but avoid project-level roles. Two safe patterns: authorized view that selects only redacted columns, or a dataset-scoped custom role.

carmen: +1 to an authorized view. Do we have a redacted table already or do traces still contain raw text?

mira: Pipeline writes telemetry.llm_redacted_traces with `redacted_text` field and `raw_text` removed. But console logs might still have raw in some debug exports — need to double-check.

alex: Proposed infra steps (high level):
1) Create dataset `telemetry_oncall_views`
2) Add an authorized view `llm_oncall_view` that SELECTs only trace_id, timestamp, redacted_text, model, latency_ms
3) Grant `bigquery.dataViewer` on `telemetry_oncall_views` to group:oncall@sre.mycompany.com
4) Ensure any Logging exports to BigQuery only target redacted tables

carmen: For console access (Logs Viewer) do we need any extra role? Logs can leak freeform text. If exports exist, block or redact them first.

mira: Example I was about to run (too broad, don't run as-is):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-prod \
  --member=group:oncall@sre.mycompany.com \
  --role=roles/bigquery.dataViewer
```
That grants too much. We should scope to dataset/view only.

ajex: (typo) alex: Also consider a custom role if you need to allow running queries limited to the view (bq.jobs.create) — but prefer the view+dataset viewer pattern so users can't query underlying tables.

jonathan: If we ever need temporary broader access during an incident, use JIT: add the user to an escalation group for 1h via sec-bot flow rather than permanent role changes.

sec-bot: Access flow available: create an incident access ticket and it will auto-expire. Use `/sec-bot request access oncall 3600 reason:"incident debug"`

mira: Can someone draft the exact commands and a PR checklist? I'll open a change once we have steps.

alex: I'll draft the PR. SQL view snippet I plan to include:
```
CREATE VIEW telemetry_oncall_views.llm_oncall_view AS
SELECT trace_id, timestamp, redacted_text, model, latency_ms, redaction_version
FROM telemetry.llm_redacted_traces;
```

carmen: Add `redaction_version` + a short note in the README about what the column means. Also add a dataprotection review step.

mira: Perfect. Thanks all — will wait for the PR and the dataprotection review. :thumbsup:
